name: Enphase Energy
old_description: Enphase Energy is headquartered in California and known for its microinverter technology for solar panels, as well as energy storage and management systems. Products are used in residential and commercial PV installations.
about:
Enphase Energy was founded in 2006 by Raghu Belur and Martin Fornage in California. The company is now headquartered in Milpitas, California, and operates as a publicly traded corporation (NASDAQ: ENPH).

The company designs and manufactures solar microinverters, battery energy storage systems, and energy management software. As of 2024, Enphase has shipped approximately 89.4 million microinverters and deployed roughly 5.3 million systems across more than 165 countries. Its global workforce numbers about 2,686 employees, and production is carried out at contract manufacturing facilities in South Carolina and Texas.

Enphase serves residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar markets. Its products are installed by a network of over 5,000 installers worldwide and are used by homeowners, businesses, and utility operators seeking distributed energy solutions. The company also provides design, permitting, and monitoring platforms—such as System Planner, Solargraf, and the Enphase App—to support installers and system owners.

Enphase says its microinverter architecture converts sunlight into a safe, reliable, and scalable energy source, with intelligent microinverters compatible with virtually any solar panel. Paired with award-winning battery technology and an industry-leading monitoring app, the system aims to give users unprecedented data and control over their energy production and consumption, advancing what the company calls a sustainable future for all.
